description.value: Swiss Chalet Motel is a locally owned, non-chain motel in the heart of Revelstoke, BC, a mountain town celebrated for deep-snow skiing, hiking, and year-round outdoor adventure. The property has 22 recently renovated rooms ranging from cozy standard queens to deluxe kings with jetted tubs and balconies, and takes genuine pride in its connection to the town's Swiss alpine-guide and CPR railway heritage. Its active-traveller focus is evident in dedicated ski and bike lockers, a resort shuttle, and exclusive Tourism Revelstoke deals available to direct-booking guests.
